title: Ethereum and Layer 1s Explained
summary: Ethereum 101 explains how Ethereum made blockchains programmable. It covers smart contracts, accounts and the EVM, ETH and gas fees, Proof of Stake, network upgrades, and how alternative Layer 1s trade off security, decentralization and scalability.

title: Ethereum treasury firm BTCS sold ether at a loss to keep $64 million Aave loan healthy
summary: The Nasdaq-listed company has 46,676 ETH backing its borrowings, and the loan could become eligible for liquidation if ether slides to around $1,700.

title: Ethlabs Calls for Ethereum Quantum Protection in 2027 as Upgrade Priorities Shift
summary: Ethlabs wants Ethereum to prioritise quantum protection in 2027, opening a debate over the scope of its next upgrades.

title: SoFi Brings Its Bank-Issued Stablecoin to Polygon’s Payments Stack
summary: SoFiUSD, the first stablecoin from a U.S. national bank, is now live on Polygon Open Money Stack alongside Ethereum and Solana.

title: Deutsche Bank Goes Live With Crypto Custody After a Five-Year Buildup
summary: Deutsche Bank’s custody service now holds Bitcoin, Ethereum and three stablecoins for institutional and corporate clients in Europe.
